findings.description: Division by zero is possible if quantity is zero, not just negative.
findings.consequence: This can lead to a DivideByZeroException and potentially expose the application to unexpected behavior or crashes.
findings.recommendation: Ensure that the quantity is strictly positive before performing the division.
